## Overview

This notebook creates visualization and QC plots on the data obtained from the differential expression analysis done by DESeq2. 

Analysis code based on that from KAUST Academy. 

Source: [https://bioinfo-kaust.github.io/academy-stage3-2026/html/lab5.html](https://bioinfo-kaust.github.io/academy-stage3-2026/html/lab5.html)

**INPUTS:**
- counts/gene_counts_matrix.tsv           — gene counts matrix
- results/tables/deseq2_all_results.csv   — all DESeq2 results
- results/tables/normalized_counts.csv    — normalized counts

**OUTPUTS:**
- library_sizes.png                              — library size bar chart
- count_boxplot_distribution.png                 — count distribution boxplot 
- count_violin_plot_distribution.png             — count distribution violin plot
- pca_conditions.png                             — PCA plot comparing conditions
- sample_correlation_heatmap.png                 — Sample correlation heatmap
- MA_plot.png                                    — MA plot (compares log2 Fold Change to Mean Expression)
- volcano_plot.png                               — Volcano plot
- top_genes_heatmap.png                          — Heatmap showing significant differentially expressed genes
- differential_expression_results_summary.txt    — Summary statistics

## Import Libraries and Set Up Output Directory

```{python}
#| label: setup
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

output_dir = os.path.expanduser("../results/figures")
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
output_dir2 = os.path.expanduser("../results/logs")

print("Libraries loaded successfully!")
```

## Load sample metadata

```{python}
#| label: load-sample-metadata

# Load data
samples = pd.read_csv("../samples.csv", sep=",")

sample_condition = dict(zip(samples["sample_id"], samples["condition"]))

condition_colors = {
    "white": "wheat",
    "blue": "royalblue",
    "red": "red", 
    "far_red": "darkred",
    "dark": "dimgrey"
}

unfilled = [s for s, c in sample_condition.items() if c not in condition_colors]
assert not unfilled, f"Fill in sample_condition for: {unfilled}"

sample_colors = {s: condition_colors[c] for s, c in sample_condition.items()}
```

## Load gene counts data
```{python}
#| label: load-gene-counts-data

# The file is a comma-separated .csv (not tab-separated, and not .tsv)
counts = pd.read_csv("../counts/gene_counts_matrix.csv", index_col=0)

missing = set(counts.columns) - set(sample_condition)
assert not missing, f"Samples in counts but not in metadata: {missing}"
counts = counts[list(sample_condition)]  # consistent column order

print(f"Gene counts matrix: {counts.shape[0]} genes x {counts.shape[1]} samples")
print(f"Samples: {list(counts.columns)}")
counts.head()

```


## Library size bar chart

```{python}
#| label: library-size-bar-chart

# Library size (total counts per sample)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(20, 12))
library_sizes = counts.sum()
bar_colors = [sample_colors[s] for s in library_sizes.index]
ax.bar(library_sizes.index, library_sizes.values / 1e6, color=bar_colors, edgecolor="black")
ax.set_ylabel("Total counts (millions)")
ax.set_title("Library Sizes")
ax.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor=c, edgecolor="black", label=k) for k, c in condition_colors.items()],
          title="Condition")
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(f"{output_dir}/library_sizes.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()
print(f"Saved to {output_dir}/library_sizes.png")
```

## PCA plot
```{python}
#| label: pca-plot

# Filter genes with low counts
counts_filtered = counts[counts.max(axis=1) >= 3]
print(f"Genes after filtering: {len(counts_filtered)}")

log_counts = np.log2(counts_filtered + 1)
data_for_pca = log_counts.T  # samples as rows

scaler = StandardScaler()
data_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(data_for_pca)

pca = PCA(n_components=4)
pca_result = pca.fit_transform(data_scaled)

pca_df = pd.DataFrame(pca_result, columns=["PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4"])
pca_df["Sample"] = data_for_pca.index
pca_df["Condition"] = [sample_condition[s] for s in data_for_pca.index]

var = pca.explained_variance_ratio_ * 100

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 7))

for ax, (px, py) in zip(axes, [("PC1", "PC2"), ("PC3", "PC4")]):
    for condition, color in condition_colors.items():
        sub = pca_df[pca_df["Condition"] == condition]
        if sub.empty:
            continue
        ax.scatter(sub[px], sub[py], c=color, label=condition, s=150,
                   edgecolors="black", linewidth=1.5)
    for _, row in pca_df.iterrows():
        ax.annotate(row["Sample"], (row[px], row[py]),
                    xytext=(5, 5), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8)
    ix, iy = int(px[2]) - 1, int(py[2]) - 1
    ax.set_xlabel(f"{px} ({var[ix]:.1f}% variance)")
    ax.set_ylabel(f"{py} ({var[iy]:.1f}% variance)")
    ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--", alpha=0.3)
    ax.axvline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--", alpha=0.3)
    ax.legend(title="Condition", loc="best")

fig.suptitle("PCA of Gene Expression: Red vs Blue vs Far Red vs White", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(f"{output_dir}/pca_conditions.png", dpi=150)
plt.show()
print(f"Saved to {output_dir}/pca_conditions.png")
```


## Load DESeq2 results
```{python}
#| label: load-deseq2-results

all_results = pd.read_csv("../results/tables/deseq2_all_results.csv")
comparisons = list(all_results["comparison"].unique())
print(f"{len(comparisons)} contrasts: {comparisons}")
print(all_results.groupby("comparison")["gene_id"].nunique())

# gene_id is the LAST column in this file, so load it by name
norm_counts = pd.read_csv("../results/tables/normalized_counts.csv", index_col="gene_id")
norm_counts = norm_counts[[s for s in sample_condition if s in norm_counts.columns]]
print(norm_counts.shape)             # expect (n_genes, 15)
print(norm_counts.index[:3].tolist())  # expect CTI12_... IDs
```

```{python}
#| label: shared-panel-grids-helper

def make_grid(n, ncols=3, panel_size=(6, 5)):
    ncols = min(ncols, n)
    nrows = int(np.ceil(n / ncols))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols,
                             figsize=(panel_size[0] * ncols, panel_size[1] * nrows),
                             squeeze=False, sharex=True, sharey=True)
    axes = axes.ravel()
    for ax in axes[n:]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return fig, axes
```

## Sample correlation heatmap
```{python}
#| label: sample-correlation-heatmap

log_norm = np.log2(norm_counts + 1)
corr_matrix = log_norm.corr()

group_colors = [sample_colors[s] for s in corr_matrix.columns]

g = sns.clustermap(corr_matrix,
                   method="average",
                   cmap="RdYlBu_r",
                   vmin=0.8, vmax=1.0,
                   figsize=(11, 11),
                   row_colors=group_colors,
                   col_colors=group_colors,
                   annot=True,
                   fmt=".3f",
                   annot_kws={"size": 7},
                   linewidths=0.5)

g.fig.suptitle("Sample Correlation Heatmap", y=1.02, fontsize=14)

plt.savefig(f"{output_dir}/sample_correlation_heatmap.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print(f"Saved to {output_dir}/sample_correlation_heatmap.png")
```

# MA plot
```{python}
#| label: ma-plot

fig, axes = make_grid(len(comparisons))

for ax, comp in zip(axes, comparisons):
    df = (all_results[all_results["comparison"] == comp]
          .dropna(subset=["padj", "log2FoldChange", "baseMean"]).copy())
    sig_mask = (df["padj"] < 0.05) & (df["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1)

    ax.scatter(np.log10(df.loc[~sig_mask, "baseMean"] + 1), df.loc[~sig_mask, "log2FoldChange"],
               c="gray", alpha=0.3, s=8, label="NS")
    ax.scatter(np.log10(df.loc[sig_mask, "baseMean"] + 1), df.loc[sig_mask, "log2FoldChange"],
               c="red", alpha=0.6, s=12, label=f"Sig ({sig_mask.sum()})")

    ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.5)
    ax.axhline(1, color="blue", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)
    ax.axhline(-1, color="blue", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)
    ax.set_ylim(-6, 6)
    ax.set_title(comp)
    ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)

fig.supxlabel("log10(Mean Expression + 1)")
fig.supylabel("log2 Fold Change")
fig.suptitle("MA Plots by Contrast", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(f"{output_dir}/MA_plot.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print(f"Saved to {output_dir}/MA_plot.png")
```

## Volcano plot
```{python}
#| label: volcano-plot

fig, axes = make_grid(len(comparisons))
reg_colors = {"Upregulated": "red", "Downregulated": "blue", "Not Significant": "gray"}

for ax, comp in zip(axes, comparisons):
    df = (all_results[all_results["comparison"] == comp]
          .dropna(subset=["pvalue", "log2FoldChange"]).copy())
    # guard against pvalue == 0 giving inf
    df["neg_log10_pval"] = -np.log10(df["pvalue"].clip(lower=1e-300))

    df["regulation"] = np.select(
        [(df["padj"] < 0.05) & (df["log2FoldChange"] > 1),
         (df["padj"] < 0.05) & (df["log2FoldChange"] < -1)],
        ["Upregulated", "Downregulated"],
        default="Not Significant",
    )

    for reg, color in reg_colors.items():
        sub = df[df["regulation"] == reg]
        ax.scatter(sub["log2FoldChange"], sub["neg_log10_pval"], c=color,
                   alpha=0.7 if reg != "Not Significant" else 0.3, s=10,
                   label=f"{reg} ({len(sub)})")

    ax.axvline(1, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axvline(-1, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8)
    ax.set_title(comp)
    ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)

fig.supxlabel("log2 Fold Change")
fig.supylabel("-log10(p-value)")
fig.suptitle("Volcano Plots by Contrast", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(f"{output_dir}/volcano_plot.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print(f"Saved to {output_dir}/volcano_plot.png")
```

## Top DE genes heatmap
```{python}
#| label: top-de-genes-heatmap

n_per_contrast = 15   # top genes per contrast; union is usually 30-45 total

sig_all = all_results[(all_results["padj"] < 0.05) &
                      (all_results["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1)]

top_genes = []
for comp in comparisons:
    top = (sig_all[sig_all["comparison"] == comp]
           .sort_values("padj").head(n_per_contrast)["gene_id"])
    print(f"{comp}: {len(top)} genes selected")
    top_genes.extend(top)
top_genes = list(dict.fromkeys(top_genes))   # unique, order preserved
print(f"Union: {len(top_genes)} genes")

top_counts = norm_counts.loc[norm_counts.index.isin(top_genes)]
print(f"Matched in norm_counts: {len(top_counts)}")

log_top = np.log2(top_counts + 1)
z_scores = log_top.sub(log_top.mean(axis=1), axis=0).div(log_top.std(axis=1), axis=0).dropna()

if len(z_scores) < 2:
    print(f"Only {len(z_scores)} gene(s) available; skipping heatmap.")
else:
    col_colors = [sample_colors[s] for s in z_scores.columns]
    g = sns.clustermap(z_scores,
                       method="average", cmap="RdBu_r", center=0, vmin=-2, vmax=2,
                       figsize=(10, max(8, 0.3 * len(z_scores))),
                       col_colors=col_colors,
                       yticklabels=True, xticklabels=True, linewidths=0.5)
    g.fig.suptitle(f"Top DE Genes Across All Contrasts ({len(z_scores)} genes, Z-score)",
                   y=1.02, fontsize=14)
    plt.savefig(f"{output_dir}/top_genes_heatmap.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print(f"Saved to {output_dir}/top_genes_heatmap.png")
```

## Summary statistics
```{python}
#| label: summary-stats

rows = []
for comp in comparisons:
    d = all_results[all_results["comparison"] == comp].dropna(subset=["padj"])
    strict = d[(d["padj"] < 0.05) & (d["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1)]
    rows.append({
        "comparison": comp,
        "genes_tested": len(d),
        "padj<0.1": (d["padj"] < 0.1).sum(),
        "padj<0.05": (d["padj"] < 0.05).sum(),
        "padj<0.01": (d["padj"] < 0.01).sum(),
        "padj<0.05 & |LFC|>1": len(strict),
        "padj<0.05 & |LFC|>2": ((d["padj"] < 0.05) & (d["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 2)).sum(),
        "up (LFC>1)": (strict["log2FoldChange"] > 0).sum(),
        "down (LFC<-1)": (strict["log2FoldChange"] < 0).sum(),
    })

summary_df = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("comparison")
print(summary_df.to_string())

with open(f"{output_dir2}/differential_expression_results_summary.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write("Summary of Differential Expression Analysis (per contrast)\n")
    f.write("=" * 60 + "\n")
    f.write(summary_df.to_string() + "\n")
```

## Notes

### Interpreting the Plots

- **MA Plot:**
    Shows relationship between expression level and fold change. Red points are significant.
- **Volcano Plot:**
    Combines fold change and statistical significance. Top corners contain the most interesting genes.
- **Correlation Heatmap:**
    Replicates should correlate highly with each other.
- **Top Genes Heatmap:**
    Shows expression patterns of the most significant genes across samples.
